race.title: Coral 'Pipped-At-The-Post' And Win Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: Winner of a point and his hurdling debut, WESTERN MONKEY shaped well after 11 months off when finishing mid-field over this C&D 22 days ago and he can build on his reappearance effort to resume winning ways. Heading the list of dangers is Harbour Light as he bids for a 5-timer, while Lihyan is another to consider from a handy mark. WESTERN MONKEY HARBOUR LIGHT LIHYAN (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Harbour Light (7/2), Alentejo (4/1), Geezer Rockstar (5/1), Isaac Des Obeaux (7/1), Western Monkey (7/1), Lihyan (10/1), Keable (12/1), Earth King (14/1), Wonderful Eagle (14/1), Inoui Machin (25/1), Deep Cave (25/1), Lallygag (33/1), Walking On Air (50/1), Moonset (50/1), Blizzard Of Oz (50/1)
